stem:
Anaya times a bead sliding along a straight wire. In each equal 1 s interval the bead covers 6 cm, 6 cm, and 6 cm.

Which claims correctly classify this straight-line motion? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The bead is in uniform linear motion because equal distances are covered in equal time intervals.
Equal distances in equal times on a straight path match constant speed.
The bead is in non-uniform linear motion because equal distances in equal times mean the speed is changing.
The bead would still be in uniform linear motion if the distances in equal times were 6 cm, 4 cm, and 9 cm.

teacher.key_rationale: Equal distances in equal times on a straight path mean uniform linear motion at constant speed. Calling that non-uniform reverses the rule, and unequal distances would not be uniform.
